normalized_outcome: Preserve and truthfully discard the exhausted V4 preload strategy, then run exactly one fresh route-schema-v5 PER_REQUEST_V1 semantic acceptance for the same parent owner outcome and bounded factual task. Continue the existing PM-mediated cycle only if the exact provider session produces both a server-observed binding receipt and an accepted canonical bound GitHub decision.
required_outcomes: The current V4 route is resolved with discard, is never marked submitted, and retains all failed-session and provider-boundary history.
Exactly one new route-schema-v5 fixture is created through the canonical durable path for the same parent owner outcome and bounded factual task.
The V5 request uses one fresh provider session and one real semantic REQUEST_BOUND_DECISION turn with Mission Control selected and no standalone preload or capability-test turn.

Before substantive reasoning, the provider calls get_supervisory_request_binding with the exact request_id, supervisor_id, and provider_session_id and requires PER_REQUEST_V1 plus the exact live request binding hash.
Success requires both the exact server-observed transport/access receipt and the canonical V5 GitHub decision accepted under the exact request binding.
Every provider send uses a fresh single-use central admission and truthful global pacing; persistent submit and capability-test gates remain disabled.
A no-MCP-receipt result after the one V5 request fails closed without retry, continuation, V4 fallback, or another provider request.
hard_boundaries: No paid model or API inference.
No manual SQLite mutation or second live EventStore writer.
No more than one V5 provider request before success or stop.
No deferred permanent hardening before PM_MEDIATED_LIVE_PROOF_PASS.
privacy_boundary: Keep detailed live host, lease, route, and execution evidence in bounded local/task receipt surfaces; do not publish it to the public issue.
